information: ## This competition is on a weekday! ​ This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UCSDWeeknightsVIII2025#64161-competitor-responsibilities-faq) tab. ​ **Spectators can attend for free** and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating. ​ This competition is organized by the Rubik's Cube Club @ UC San Diego, in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/). ​ ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTc4Nzk1LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--4b75c6f23c4c32d7dde27ffa29729eaef6f4307c/image.png)
